info.name: Prisma Data Platform API
info.description:
REST API for managing Prisma Data Platform resources including projects, environments, and database connections through the Prisma Console. Provides programmatic access to workspace management, API key generation, and platform resource configuration.

Contact Support:
 Name: Prisma Support
 Email: support@prisma.io
